notes: MiSTer Control 0.8.0  - MC-Gameboy: MiSTer Control's own Gameboy core (DMG, GBC, SGB) with per-frame telemetry, a save-state-safe RAM mirror and input replay; installs from Settings > Install next to the stock core. The telemetry reader takes each core's geometry from its header (layout 3). - Play uses the MiSTer Control core by default when one is installed for the system (switch in Settings > cores). - Gameboy RAM map for Super Mario Land (score, lives, time), checked live. - RetroAchievements: odelot's main and fifteen RA cores as catalog items, an RA card in Settings, the RA-core launch preference. - Games from USB drives and network shares, in the firmware's own order, as one library; a persistent library index (a start answers in 0.09 s instead of 12 s). - H.264 live view over the WebSocket with WebCodecs decode and a JPEG fallback; an HTTPS listener on :8111. - Speedrun timer with auto-splits from telemetry; streamer overlay pages and marquee mode for OBS; OBS scene switching. - BizHawk .bk2 movies for NES and Gameboy. - Fixed: the library picker could sit empty after a launch (a per-second poll of a 50 s endpoint starved the page's requests); /api/ra answers in under a second.
